cards.title: What is Lazy Loading?
cards.content:
Lazy Loading

Lazy loading is a technique where parts of the application (like feature modules or standalone components) are loaded only when needed. This reduces the initial bundle size and speeds up application load time.

cards.title: Lazy Loading Standalone Components
cards.content:
loadComponent

For standalone components, you use the loadComponent property in your route configuration and provide a dynamic import.

{
  path: 'admin',
  loadComponent: () => import('./admin/admin.component').then(m => m.AdminComponent)
}

cards.title: Lazy Loading Routes
cards.content:
loadChildren

To lazy load a set of routes, you use loadChildren.

{
  path: 'dashboard',
  loadChildren: () => import('./dashboard/dashboard.routes').then(m => m.DASHBOARD_ROUTES)
}

You can also configure Preloading Strategies (like PreloadAllModules) to load lazy routes in the background after the initial load.
